enonce_intro_markdown: The probability that it will rain on a particular day is $\dfrac{3}{5}$.
incertitudes: Question 15(b) : le sujet ne dit pas que les deux jours sont independants ; le corrige le suppose, comme le fait le programme O/L.

questions.enonce_markdown: Find the probability that it will not rain on that day.
Find the probability that it may rain for two consecutive days. *[6 marks for the whole question]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Assume the weather on the two days is independent. Rain on day 1 AND rain on day 2:

$\dfrac{3}{5} \times \dfrac{3}{5} = \dfrac{9}{25}$.

**Answer: $\dfrac{9}{25}$ (or $0.36$).**
